/**
 * @name All classes in package
 * @description Find all classes defined in the aiosignal package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @id py/aiosignal-classes

select cls, "Class: " + cls.getName() + " at " + cls.getLocation().toString()

import python

where

select loop, "Loop executing callbacks at line " + loop.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()

where

select loop, "Iteration over callbacks at line " + loop.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unbounded collection growth
 * @description Collections that grow without bounds may lead to memory exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unbounded-collection-growth
 * @tags security
 *        denial-of-service
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getAttributeName() = "append" or
  call.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getAttributeName() = "extend" or
  call.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getAttributeName() = "add"
select call, "Collection modification that may grow unbounded."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unbounded list/collection growth that could lead to memory exhaustion DoS

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unchecked callable invocation
 * @description Invoking objects without checking if they are callable may raise TypeError
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unchecked-callable
 * @tags reliability
 *        external/cwe/cwe-754
 */

import python

from Call call
where
  not exists(Call checkCall |
    checkCall.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "callable" and
    checkCall.getArg(0).toString() = call.getFunc().toString()
  )
select call, "Invocation without checking if object is callable."
findings.hypothesis: Check for TypeError or AttributeError possibilities when invoking callbacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential type confusion in callback registration
 * @description Registering non-callable objects as callbacks may cause runtime errors
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/type-confusion-callback
 * @tags security
 *        reliability
 *        external/cwe/cwe-843
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string methodName
where
  methodName in ["append", "extend", "insert"] and
  exists(Attribute attr |
    attr.getName() = methodName and
    call.getFunction().asExpr() = attr
  ) and
  not exists(Call callableCheck |
    callableCheck.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "callable"
  )
select call, "Method call '" + methodName + "' without validation that argument is callable."
findings.hypothesis: Callbacks may be registered without checking if they are callable, leading to type confusion and runtime errors

message.text: Method call 'append' without validation that argument is callable.
